"''He'll be with you shortly. He's just finishing with the regional governor.|The criminal [[Tobias Beckett]] and Crimson Dawn member [[Margo]] discuss the governor's meeting with Dryden Vos|audio=BeckettAndMargo.flac|}} '''Diles Anevi''' was the [[human]] [[governor]] of the [[Expansion Region]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]], he met with [[Dryden Vos]], leader of the [[Crimson Dawn]] criminal organization, aboard Vos's [[Nau'ur-class yacht|yacht]], the ''[[First Light]]''. The aim of the meeting was to strike a deal over waiving certain transit restrictions on Crimson Dawn [[starship]]s traveling along the [[Great Gran Run]] [[Hyperspace route|trade route]]. In return, Anevi hoped to persuade Vos to make financial contributions to charitable causes, but Vos lost his temper during the meeting and stabbed Anevi with a [[Petar|Kyuzo petar]], [[Death|killing]] him. ==Biography== {{Quote|I get all worked up. Silly. It's a party.|Dryden Vos muses on his murder of Diles Anevi|audio=Dryden-Silly.flac|}} [[File:Anevi_Death.png|thumb|left|215px|Dryden Vos killed Diles Anevi.]] Diles Anevi was a [[human]] who served as [[governor]] of the [[Expansion Region]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]], he met with the leader of the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate, [[Dryden Vos]], aboard the [[crime lord]]'s [[Nau'ur-class yacht|yacht]], the ''[[First Light]]'', while it was docked in [[Fort Ypso]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]]. The aim of the meeting was for a deal to be struck that would waive certain travel restrictions on Crimson Dawn [[starship]]s moving along the [[Great Gran Run]] [[hyperspace route]]. Anevi hoped that in return he could secure from Vos financial contributions to charitable causes he cared deeply about. During the meeting, Vos lost his temper and stabbed Anevi in the chest with a [[Petar|Kyuzo petar]], causing him to let out a cry of pain that could be heard by party guests on the [[yacht]]'s [[observation deck]].''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' When Vos removed the blade, the governor dropped to the floor [[Death|dead]]. His corpse was dragged away by one of the crime [[lord]]'s [[Hylobon Enforcers]] as Vos cleaned the weapon and took a drink. ==Personality and traits== The governor had light skin, dark [[eye]]s, and [[Color|graying-brown]] [[hair]]. ==Equipment== At the [[time]] of his death, Diles Anevi wore a gray [[gaberwool]] [[Clothing|mantle of office]] over a black shirt and pants, along with black [[boot]]s and a [[belt]] buckle that contained his transactional [[credit chip]] portfolio. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|There was a debate about how Dryden would dispose of that unfortunate regional governor. Some of us really wanted him decapitated and we actually shot a version where a head rolls across the floor. Others felt that was a little too rough for Star Wars.|Jon Kasdan|{{Twitter|JonKasdan|status/1040529505670946817|[[Jon Kasdan]]|quote=continued|archivefile=File:Jon-Kasdan-SoloFacts-September-14-2018.png|archivedate=20200114055629}}}} [[File:Anevi_Alternate.png|thumb|right|250px|Despite Miles Richardson being credited with playing Diles Anevi in ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'', the character is visibly played by a different actor in the film.]] Diles Anevi first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', and was first identified by name in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The credits for the film identify [[Miles Richardson]] as the actor portraying the "Regional Governor," and the ''Official Guide'' also contains an image of Richardson in the role; however, in the film itself, the governor is clearly portrayed by a different bearded actor. During the filming of ''Solo'', the production staff debated how exactly Dryden Vos would dispose of Anevi. Screenwriter [[Jon Kasdan]] and others wanted to have Vos decapitate Anevi, and a version in which Anevi's head rolls across the floor was filmed, but some felt that would be too graphic for a ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, so the decapitation version of the scene was ultimately cut. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Diles Anevi}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 2|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 2]] {{Corpse}} ==Sources== *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story – The Official Collector's Edition|''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Po}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' {{1stID|Diles Anevi}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: The Ultimate Guide]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Diles Anevi |de=Diles Anevi |fr=Diles Anevi |ja=ダイルズ・アネヴィ |ka=დაილს ანევი |pl=Diles Anevi }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Anevi, Diles}} [[Category:Bureaucrats]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
